summary_en: This study tests tacabrutideg (BGB-16673) given together with other medicines in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancies. Tacabrutideg is taken by mouth, and it is combined with sonrotoclax, zanubrutinib, mosunetuzumab, or glofitamab, with obinutuzumab given before glofitamab; how long or how often treatment is given is not stated. The study measures safety, preliminary antitumor activity, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics; the study is Phase 1/2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tacabrutideg (BGB-16673) administrado junto con otros medicamentos en adultos con neoplasias de células B recidivantes o refractarias. Tacabrutideg se toma por vía oral y se combina con sonrotoclax, zanubrutinib, mosunetuzumab o glofitamab, y se administra obinutuzumab antes de glofitamab; no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se da el tratamiento. El estudio mide la seguridad, la actividad antitumoral preliminar, la farmacocinética y la farmacodinamia; es un estudio de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Confirmed relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancy
Measurable disease as defined by the protocol
Adequate kidney function (eGFR of at least 50 mL/min, or at least 30 mL/min in substudy 2)
not_for: Active leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled, untreated brain metastasis
Other cancer within 2 years before first dose, unless treated curatively or it is the cancer under study
Autologous stem cell transplant or CAR T-cell therapy within 3 months before screening
Prior Bcl-2 inhibitor treatment (substudy 1), or prior CD20 x CD3 T-cell engager treatment (substudies 3 and 4)
